thread:
caroline: Morning all — quick async standup for deals with KMS/HSM asks. TL;DR: sent integration checklist to MacroHealth; need a small HSM test harness and a dev KMS key sample from infra.

caroline: What I did: emailed MacroHealth the onboarding checklist + compliance attachments; synced with legal about contract clause for key custodianship.

caroline: Blockers: MacroHealth asked for an HSM-wrapped key example and a short demo of dedicated/private deploy behavior under our KMS integration. They also want a patch-level timeline for PR #421 (HSM adapter).

ryan: Re: PR #421 — it's in review, left comments on the key-wrap API doc yesterday. I can push the small test harness by EOD if SRE confirms a disposable HSM simulator in staging.

james: I've got the HSM threat model ready and a short FAQ for customers. I can add a short section about key escalation paths. Will drop it into the checklist repo.

li: Ops note — we have a software HSM simulator (hsm-sim) in staging; needs a service account with kms:test:keywrap perms. I can provision that for a short window. pinging @sre-bot for scheduling.

sre-bot: @li confirmed — provisioning slot for hsm-sim tomorrow 09:00-11:00 UTC. Please file a brief runbook with success criteria.

ryan: Sweet. For the test harness I'll include a tiny curl snippet customers can run against the simulator. Example:
```
curl -X POST https://staging-infra.example.keywrap/v1/wrap \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \ 
  -d '{"key_id":"test-key-01","plaintext":"base64-payload"}'
```
That should be enough for MacroHealth to validate key wrapping approach.

emma: From AE side — MacroHealth legal also wants to confirm HSM audit log exports format. James, can you attach an example export? If not, can SRE produce a sample sanitized export from staging?

james: Yep, I can attach a redacted audit sample. Planning to add to the thread in the checklist repo.

li: I'll generate a sanitized audit export during the simulator window and drop it in the secure share.

caroline: Riskiest blocker is timeline for PR -> deploy to private pilot env. Ryan, can you give an estimated path (code review -> staging -> canary -> pilot) with rough times? MacroHealth is asking for dates.

ryan: Estimate: review + address comments: 1 business day. Merge -> staging rollout: same day (automated). Canary (private pilot) after QA signoff: 2 more business days. So ~4 business days end-to-end assuming no regressions.

caroline: Great. I'll tell MacroHealth that we can demo within a week assuming the simulator run goes green.

emma: Also note: pricing lead needs to confirm dedicated capacity quote if they want isolated HSM-backed keys. I'll follow up this afternoon.

caroline: Action items: 
- ryan: finish test harness + address PR comments (ETA EOD).
- li: provision hsm-sim slot & produce sanitized audit export (tomorrow window).
- james: attach redacted audit sample + update checklist FAQ.
- emma: confirm dedicated capacity quote with pricing.
- caroline: update MacroHealth with demo window and timeline.

caroline: Quick asks: @ryan — can you ping me when PR is updated? Also bump the PR in #eng-releases if ready.

ryan: Will do. ping me if you need me to join the call.

emma: :thumbsup: I'll also set a follow-up call in the calendar after the simulator run.

caroline: Thanks team — short and focused. If anything blocks the simulator window, call it out here and I'll escalate.

ops-bot: Reminder: Please attach runbook to ticket INF-789 before provisioning.

caroline: Noted, will attach runbook in INF-789 before end of day.
